question: What proportional measures are permitted for the extent of the wall?
premises: The wall extent may measure one-and-a-half parts.
The wall extent may measure one part.
The wall extent may be equal in measure.
inference: The extent of the wall is permitted in alternative proportions of one-and-a-half parts, one part, or equal measure.
plain_english: The extent of the wall may be one-and-a-half parts, one part, or equal.
